competition.title: AI MIND MASTERS – FIRST ROUND
competition.institution: KLE Society’s College of BBA, Mahalingpur

questions.text: What is Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
options: Technology that enables machines to perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence
questions.explanation: AI enables machines to perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence.

questions.text: Who is widely known as the father of Artificial Intelligence?
questions.explanation: John McCarthy coined the term Artificial Intelligence in 1956 and is widely regarded as its father.

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of a generative AI chatbot?
questions.explanation: ChatGPT by OpenAI is a prominent generative AI conversational model.

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of Machine Learning?
options: Learning patterns from data to make predictions or decisions
questions.explanation: Machine Learning focuses on learning patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.

questions.text: Which of the following is an AI-powered virtual assistant?
questions.explanation: Amazon Alexa is an AI-driven smart voice assistant.

questions.text: What does NLP stand for in Artificial Intelligence?
questions.explanation: NLP stands for Natural Language Processing.

questions.text: Which AI technology enables computers to interpret images and videos?
questions.explanation: Computer vision allows machines to process, analyze, and interpret visual data.

questions.text: What is a chatbot?
options: A software program designed to communicate with users through conversation
questions.explanation: A chatbot is an automated conversational software application.

questions.text: What is generative AI primarily designed to do?
options: Generate new content such as text, images, audio, or code
questions.explanation: Generative AI creates new content like text, imagery, audio, and code based on prompts.

questions.text: Which is a common application of AI in email services?
questions.explanation: AI algorithms detect unsolicited spam and phishing attempts in modern email platforms.

questions.text: How can AI help a business forecast sales?
options: By analysing historical sales, trends, and market data
questions.explanation: Predictive AI models analyze historical trends, seasonality, and external factors to forecast demand.

questions.text: How can AI assist human resource management?
options: By guaranteeing every applicant a job
By eliminating the need for workplace policies
By supporting résumé screening and recruitment workflows
By automatically deciding every promotion without review
questions.explanation: AI supports HR teams by parsing résumés and screening candidate qualifications efficiently.

questions.text: What is a major business benefit of AI automation?
options: Improved efficiency and reduced repetitive work
questions.explanation: Automation reduces manual repetitive chores, freeing workers for higher-value tasks.

questions.text: Which AI application estimates future customer demand using data?
questions.explanation: Predictive analytics utilizes statistical algorithms and machine learning to project future outcomes.

questions.text: A company analyses customer reviews to identify positive and negative opinions. Which AI technique is most relevant?
questions.explanation: Sentiment analysis identifies and categorizes subjective opinions expressed in text.

questions.text: What is a key purpose of data analytics in business?
options: Analysing information to identify patterns and support decisions
questions.explanation: Data analytics uncovers actionable patterns to guide evidence-based business choices.

questions.text: What is Robotic Process Automation (RPA) commonly used for?
options: Designing physical robots for factories only
questions.explanation: RPA automates rule-based digital workflows across legacy and modern business systems.

questions.text: Which is an example of AI in customer service?
options: A virtual assistant that answers customer queries
questions.explanation: Virtual AI customer assistants offer 24/7 self-service query resolution.

questions.text: How can AI help manufacturing companies?
options: By guaranteeing that machines never fail
By eliminating the need for safety procedures
By predicting equipment failures from sensor data
questions.explanation: Predictive maintenance algorithms anticipate equipment wear using IoT sensor data.

questions.text: What is a sensible first step when introducing AI into a business?
options: Identify a problem, pilot a solution, and measure the results
Purchase the most expensive AI software
questions.explanation: Effective AI adoption starts with clear problem definition, pilot validation, and ROI measurement.

questions.text: Which online business activity commonly uses AI recommendation systems?
options: Suggesting products on an online shopping website
questions.explanation: E-commerce recommendation engines suggest relevant products based on browse and purchase history.

questions.text: What is customer segmentation?
options: Charging every customer a different price without a reason
Dividing customers into groups with similar characteristics or behaviours
questions.explanation: Customer segmentation groups buyers by shared demographics, needs, or buying patterns.

questions.text: How can AI support digital advertising?
options: By guaranteeing every advertisement goes viral
By removing the need to understand customers
By ensuring every campaign produces profit
By helping target audiences and optimise advertising campaigns
questions.explanation: AI optimizes ad delivery, bidding, creative testing, and audience targeting in real time.

questions.text: What does Click-Through Rate (CTR) measure?
options: The percentage of impressions that result in clicks
The total number of employees in a company
The cost of manufacturing a product
The number of products in a warehouse
questions.explanation: CTR = (Total Clicks / Total Impressions) * 100%.

questions.text: Which technique can help a company understand customer opinions on social media?
questions.explanation: Sentiment analysis gauges public sentiment and brand perception across social channels.

questions.text: How does an AI recommendation engine personalise a shopping experience?
options: By displaying only the most expensive products
By showing random products to every user
By suggesting items based on preferences and behaviour
By preventing customers from comparing products
questions.explanation: Recommendations reflect tailored interests and inferred customer intent.

questions.text: What is A/B testing in digital marketing?
options: Comparing two versions to determine which performs better
Creating two customer accounts for every user
questions.explanation: A/B testing splits traffic between variants A and B to test conversion rates.

questions.text: How can generative AI help a marketing team?
options: By drafting marketing content and suggesting campaign ideas
questions.explanation: Generative tools assist copywriters by brainstorming slogans, emails, and social posts.

questions.text: What does SEO stand for?
questions.explanation: SEO stands for Search Engine Optimization.

questions.text: What should a business avoid when publishing AI-generated marketing content?
options: Checking whether the content suits its audience
Publishing misleading claims or inaccurate information
questions.explanation: Brands must verify facts to avoid false advertising, hallucinated specs, or misleading claims.

questions.text: How can AI help banks identify potential fraud?
options: By treating every customer as suspicious
questions.explanation: Anomaly detection models spot anomalous spending amounts, foreign locations, and velocity spikes.

questions.text: Which technology can extract printed text from scanned invoices?
questions.explanation: OCR converts printed or typed text into editable, searchable machine data.

questions.text: What is algorithmic trading?
options: Trading based entirely on handwritten records
Using computer algorithms to execute trading decisions
questions.explanation: Algorithmic trading executes market orders via pre-programmed automated quantitative strategies.

questions.text: How can AI assist a bank during credit assessment?
options: By guaranteeing that borrowers repay every loan
By analysing relevant financial and credit data
By ignoring the applicant's financial circumstances
questions.explanation: AI evaluates creditworthiness by processing credit history, cash flows, and debt-to-income ratios.

questions.text: What is an important limitation of AI-based financial predictions?
options: Predictions can be wrong because of uncertainty, data quality, or changing conditions
questions.explanation: Financial markets are volatile, subject to black swan events and unpredictable external shifts.

questions.text: Which technology can convert printed receipts into searchable digital text?
questions.explanation: OCR (Optical Character Recognition) transforms receipt photos into structured expense records.

questions.text: How can AI assist an organisation's expense management?
options: By guaranteeing that all expenses are legitimate
By removing the need for financial records
By classifying expenses and flagging unusual claims
questions.explanation: AI categorizes expenditures and detects policy violations or duplicated claim receipts.

questions.text: What is a common use of AI in personal finance applications?
questions.explanation: Finance apps auto-classify debits into Groceries, Utilities, Travel, and Entertainment.

questions.text: A fraud detection system incorrectly flags a genuine payment as fraudulent. What is this called?
questions.explanation: A false positive occurs when a harmless, genuine event is erroneously marked as an anomaly.

questions.text: What is an essential practice when deploying AI in financial services?
options: Reviewing errors, fairness, risks, and accountability
Allowing AI to make every decision without oversight
questions.explanation: Financial AI requires strict compliance audits, model governance, explainability, and bias checks.

questions.text: Which company developed ChatGPT?
questions.explanation: ChatGPT was created and launched by OpenAI in November 2022.

questions.text: Which platform is widely used to create posters, presentations, and social media graphics with AI-assisted features?
questions.explanation: Canva integrates AI design features like Magic Studio for visual graphic creation.

questions.text: What is a prompt in generative AI?
options: An instruction or input given to an AI system
questions.explanation: A prompt is the natural language cue or command passed to a generative model.

questions.text: Which Microsoft application is primarily used for spreadsheets and numerical analysis?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Excel is the standard spreadsheet application for numerical data analysis.

questions.text: What is an AI hallucination?
options: Incorrect or fabricated information generated by an AI system
A computer losing its internet connection
questions.explanation: Hallucination refers to plausible-sounding but factually untrue or fabricated AI outputs.

questions.text: What is the main purpose of a business dashboard?
options: To display key performance indicators (KPIs) and business information
To store passwords in plain text
questions.explanation: Dashboards synthesize core metrics and KPIs into visual, easily digestable charts.

questions.text: Which of the following is a popular AI assistant developed by Google?
questions.explanation: Gemini is Google's advanced multimodal AI assistant and foundation model.

questions.text: Which AI tool is commonly associated with generating images from text prompts?
questions.explanation: DALL-E by OpenAI converts descriptive text prompts into realistic images and artwork.

questions.text: Which of the following is a popular AI coding assistant developed by GitHub and Microsoft in collaboration with OpenAI technology?
questions.explanation: GitHub Copilot suggests real-time code completions inside developers' IDEs.

questions.text: Which AI capability is most useful for summarising a long business report?
options: Natural language processing and text generation
questions.explanation: NLP summarization algorithms condense long documents into concise executive briefings.

questions.text: What is AI bias?
options: Systematic unfairness in AI outputs or decisions
questions.explanation: AI bias arises when training data or algorithms produce systematic discrimination or prejudiced results.

questions.text: Why should confidential business information be handled carefully when using AI tools?
options: It may expose sensitive information or violate privacy requirements
Confidential information is always publicly available
Sharing it guarantees better AI accuracy
questions.explanation: Pasting proprietary trade secrets into public AI tools can lead to data leaks and GDPR/privacy infractions.

questions.text: What is the purpose of human oversight in AI systems?
options: To prevent computers from storing data
To review important decisions, correct errors, and ensure accountability
questions.explanation: Human-in-the-loop ensures legal compliance, moral accountability, and mistake prevention.

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of responsible AI use?
options: Checking AI-generated information before relying on it
Sharing customer passwords with an AI chatbot
Using AI to discriminate against applicants
questions.explanation: Fact-checking and human verification are pillars of responsible AI deployment.

questions.text: What does explainable AI aim to achieve?
options: Guarantee that every prediction is correct
Make AI decisions and outputs more understandable to people
questions.explanation: Explainable AI (XAI) clarifies how and why neural models reach specific conclusions.

questions.text: What is a deepfake?
options: AI-generated or manipulated audio, image, or video content that can imitate real people or events
A secure method of backing up files
questions.explanation: Deepfakes use synthetic media generation to simulate authentic likenesses of people.

questions.text: Why should organisations monitor AI systems after deployment?
options: To ensure they never need software updates
To detect performance changes, errors, and emerging risks
To guarantee that customer preferences never change
questions.explanation: Post-deployment monitoring catches data drift, concept drift, and emergent failure modes.

questions.text: What is the best response when an AI system provides a suspicious or unsupported factual claim?
options: Verify it using reliable sources before relying on it
Assume it is correct because AI generated it
questions.explanation: Always cross-reference unverified outputs with authoritative primary sources.

questions.text: Which statement best describes the relationship between AI and human intelligence?
options: AI is always superior to humans in every task
AI can never perform useful tasks
Human review is never needed when using AI
AI can assist with many tasks, while human judgment remains important in context-sensitive decisions
questions.explanation: AI serves as cognitive augmentation, while humans provide ethics, empathy, and nuanced judgment.

questions.text: Which skill is most valuable for students preparing to work with AI in business?
options: Combining AI literacy, critical thinking, data skills, and ethical judgment
Memorising AI-generated answers without understanding them
questions.explanation: Future leaders thrive by combining AI proficiency, critical reasoning, and ethical responsibility.
